UPDATE team_media_quota SET used_file_count = GREATEST(used_file_count - 1, 0), used_bytes = GREATEST(used_bytes - #{fileSize}, 0), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
